subject: Verify: build, lint, and run all tests
description:
Final verification step:
1. Run `npm run build` — TypeScript must compile with strict mode, no errors
2. Run `npm run test:run` — all unit and integration tests must pass
3. Verify the dist/ output structure matches package.json expectations (dist/index.js, dist/cli/generate.js)
4. Verify .gitignore includes node_modules, dist, .env

Fix any issues found.

Depends on: all previous tasks
